intent: The shared not-connected page's one remedy becomes a target, not a sentence: the connect link wears button/secondary.
rationale: DT-0004 deferred this component because it is shared by every authenticated page — restyling it once restyles being-turned-away everywhere. Its whole job is to hand the person the one action that fixes their situation, and today that action is an underlined phrase inside a paragraph. DT-0001 already ruled this exact case on strategy-not-found: 'a single link … styled as button/secondary so the way out is a target rather than a sentence.' This extends that ruling to the way *in*. The message paragraphs are untouched — the wording arrives from the use case and is behavior.

design.layout: Unchanged: the standard shell (centred max-w-2xl, space.5 padding, heading at type.size.xl / type.weight.medium), heading, the message, then the action.

default.content: H1 'Not connected', the message paragraph verbatim, then 'Connect your BattleGrid account' as an anchor wearing BUTTON_SECONDARY — a bordered peer-weight target at min-height size.control.min, inheriting secondary's hover and active from control.ts. It is the page's only action, and secondary rather than primary is deliberate: the committing acts in this product wear primary, and this is navigation to the page where the actual grant is read and agreed.

responsive.mobile: The anchor keeps its natural width — a lone full-bleed control on an otherwise empty page reads as a form that is not there.

motion.hover: Inherited from BUTTON_SECONDARY — border to color.border.strong, background to color.bg.sunken over motion.duration.fast.

content.note: No copy changes. The message and the link text are behavior.

acceptance: The connect link is an <a> wearing the BUTTON_SECONDARY constant — not a per-page className and not a <button>
The link text is unchanged: 'Connect your BattleGrid account'
The message paragraphs render verbatim, before the action
The anchor meets the 44px floor via the constant's min-h-control
Hover responds — border color.border.strong, background color.bg.sunken — inherited, not restated
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: DT-0001's strategy-not-found treatment is the precedent ('the way out is a target rather than a sentence'); DT-0004 deferred this component by name. Shared component: this lands once in require-connection.tsx and every page inherits it.
